stories.title: Donald Trump signe avec le Danemark et le Groenland un accord après des mois de tensions

en.title: Donald Trump signs agreement with Denmark and Greenland after months of tensions
en.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump signed an agreement with Denmark and Greenland aimed at strengthening security in the Arctic and North Atlantic. The agreement includes increased American military presence on the island while maintaining Danish control of the territory.

stories.title: Flambée des prix des carburants : le gouvernement augmente le plafond de la prime carburant versée par les employeurs, de 600 à 1 000 euros par an

en.title: Facing fuel price surge, government increases employer fuel allowance cap from 600 to 1,000 euros per year
en.summary: The French government raised the maximum fuel allowance that employers can provide to employees from 600 to 1,000 euros annually. This tax-exempt and social-charge-exempt benefit remains optional for employers.

stories.title: Donald Trump affirme à l'Assemblée générale de l'ONU qu'il doit décider entre "anéantir" l'Iran ou passer un "accord"

en.title: Donald Trump tells UN General Assembly he must choose between "annihilating" Iran or reaching an "agreement"
en.summary: At the UN General Assembly, U.S. President Donald Trump stated he will not allow Iran to obtain nuclear weapons and indicated he faces a choice between reaching an accord or military action.

stories.title: A l’Assemblée générale de l’ONU, Donald Trump dit devoir décider entre passer un « accord » avec l’Iran ou « anéantir » ce pays

en.title: At UN General Assembly, Donald Trump says he must choose between reaching an "agreement" with Iran or "annihilating" the country
en.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump addressed the UN while struggling to resolve the conflict with Iran that he initiated with Israel in late February.

stories.title: EN DIRECT – Assemblée générale de l’ONU : Donald Trump assure qu’un accord sera trouvé avec l’Iran après les «midterms»

en.title: LIVE – UN General Assembly: Donald Trump assures agreement will be found with Iran after 'midterms'
en.summary: The annual UN General Assembly begins in New York, with US President Trump addressing the body. Discussion topics include Middle Eastern and Ukrainian conflicts, climate change, and AI regulation.

stories.title: Flambée des prix des carburants : comment les autres pays européens s'organisent

en.title: Surge in fuel prices: how other European countries are organizing
en.summary: European nations including Belgium, Germany, Italy, and Spain are implementing various measures to address rising fuel prices. France has announced new policy responses to the energy crisis affecting the continent.

stories.title: Assemblée générale de l'ONU : "L'Amérique est de retour", se félicite Donald Trump lors de son discours

en.title: UN General Assembly: "America is back", Donald Trump congratulates himself during his speech
en.summary: US President Trump delivered a speech at the UN headquarters in New York, declaring he has made the United States the most powerful country in the world.

stories.title: EN DIRECT - Assemblée générale de l’ONU : Donald Trump assure qu’il doit choisir entre «anéantir» l’Iran ou passer un «accord»

en.title: LIVE - UN General Assembly: Donald Trump assures he must choose between "annihilating" Iran or reaching an "agreement"
en.summary: During his UN address, President Trump characterized the Iranian regime as weak and desperate, presenting a choice between military action or diplomatic negotiations.

stories.title: 🔴 En direct : Donald Trump s'adresse à l'Assemblée générale de l'ONU en pleine guerre avec l'Iran

en.title: Live: Donald Trump addresses UN General Assembly amid tensions with Iran
en.summary: Donald Trump is addressing the UN General Assembly during a period of heightened tensions with Iran.

stories.title: On vous résume le bras de fer entre Donald Trump et les médias traditionnels américains exclus de la Maison Blanche

en.title: Summary: The standoff between Donald Trump and major American news networks excluded from the White House
en.summary: Four major American television networks decided not to cover the President's inauguration of a large helicopter platform at the White House on Monday.

stories.title: Assemblée générale de l'ONU : à quoi peut-on s'attendre de Donald Trump ?

en.title: UN General Assembly: What can we expect from Donald Trump?
en.summary: Emmanuel Macron proposed several initiatives to Donald Trump on September 21 to address rising oil prices, including a UN resolution on the Strait of Hormuz and an energy truce in the Ukraine conflict.

stories.title: Ukraine, Moyen-Orient : Emmanuel Macron assure avoir eu «une discussion très constructive» avec Donald Trump

en.title: Ukraine, Middle East: Emmanuel Macron says he had "a very constructive discussion" with Donald Trump
en.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron met with Donald Trump at the margins of the UN General Assembly in New York after visiting Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon.

stories.title: Géospatial : l’Allemagne devient cliente de Planet

en.title: Geospatial: Germany becomes Planet customer
en.summary: The German federal government's interior ministry will become a client of Planet, receiving geospatial data through the company's German subsidiary.

stories.title: Muse plus fort que ChatGPT ? Comment l'IA de Meta est devenue la plus en vogue

en.title: Muse stronger than ChatGPT? How Meta's AI became the most popular
en.summary: Meta's new conversational agent Muse reached the top of App Store downloads in just twelve days, potentially becoming a new consumption standard through Meta's social media dominance and partnerships with Shopify.

stories.title: Nucléaire : l'EPR de Flamanville va être mis à l'arrêt pendant près d'un an

en.title: Nuclear: Flamanville EPR to be shut down for nearly one year
en.summary: Flamanville's EPR reactor will stop on September 26 for a 50-week inspection mandated by law within 30 months after fuel arrival, allowing a comprehensive review of the facility.

stories.title: Traînées de condensation : Air France mène des tests à grande échelle

en.title: Contrails: Air France conducts large-scale tests
en.summary: Air France published results from a study aimed at reducing persistent contrail formation, which contributes to climate warming.

stories.title: OPINION. « La présomption de légitime défense est un passeport d’impunité », par Vincent Brengarth

en.title: OPINION. "The presumption of self-defense is a passport to impunity", by Vincent Brengarth
en.summary: Lawyer Vincent Brengarth argues that a proposed law establishing a presumption of self-defense for law enforcement threatens the balance between protecting officers and judicial oversight of their actions.
